name: Wire work
summary: Actors hang on thin steel wires, so that they fly, leap and turn in a fight faster and higher than a body can.
how: Hide the wires against the background, or remove them in post-production.
Cut on the peak of each leap; keep each air shot under 2 s.
Mix wire shots with ground shots at real speed, so that the flight reads as a skill.

origin.note: Wuxia films such as Zu Warriors from the Magic Mountain hang actors on wires for flying fights.

adoptions.via: Yuen Woo-ping choreographs the wire fights of The Matrix for Hollywood.
